goal: Improve the current Apatosaurus first image without changing its locked low-neck diplodocid silhouette by reducing pale edge/background-mask residue and adding a conservative contact-shadow/volume polish.

experiments.finding: Rejected. The body contrast and grounding improved, but the pass made stale background-mask residue behind the animal more visible.

experiments.type: background-residue cleanup plus subtle contact shadow
experiments.finding: Selected. The v2b pass is conservative: it preserves the full silhouette and low-neck anatomy while slightly softening background residue and improving the contact-shadow read without adding new anatomy drift.

decision.reason: This is a small app-first improvement over the previous floodplain candidate. It does not solve body flatness completely, but it keeps the low-neck count gate intact and reduces the most visible compositing residue without requiring a risky full-body regeneration.
decision.nextRoute: For final-quality Apatosaurus, use a stronger sauropod-specific generation route or train a sauropod silhouette/background LoRA; keep local polish passes conservative so the low-neck diplodocid shape is not lost.
